mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS post_id, review_id AS review_id, review_title AS review_title, review_content AS review_content, review_date AS review_date, review_count AS review_count, review_like_count AS review_like_count FROM community_post_review ORDER BY post_id DESC

SELECT p.post_id, r.review_id, r.review_title, r.review_content, p.post_date AS review_date, p.post_count AS review_count, p.post_like_count AS review_like_count FROM post p JOIN community_post_review r ON p.post_id = r.post_id WHERE p.target_type = #{targetType} ORDER BY p.post_date DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{count}
